bull.probability_evidence: Every multiple sits below its own 5y minimum (P/FCF 12.0x vs 17.1x floor; FCF yield 8.37%) and FCF conversion of 127.8% TTM keeps funding buybacks (shares -3.71% YoY) even without a re-rating catalyst (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation/Quality/Other); but the upside case requires the China strategic review to actually resolve into a partnership or exit, an unconfirmed, open-ended process tagged [Guessing] in the evaluation's Bull case (note.md §2,§6 '10-Q: strategic review of partnerships and other alternatives'), and the macro overlay finds no stock-specific macro tailwind, treating rate/dollar moves as generic and keeping the overlay at 'context' weight (research/AOS/2026-10-07-macro.md) -- hence the minority 25% weight.

target_band.cite: Half the spread of implied prices re-rating each multiple to its own 5y median on the 56.90 close (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Price, HI): P/E 15.4x->22.0x = 81.29; EV/EBITDA 10.4x->12.3x = 67.30 (matches the bull basis's own re-rate anchor); EV/Sales 2.1x->2.6x = 70.45; P/B 4.2x->5.3x = 71.80 (factsheet Valuation table, RA). P/FCF (12.0x vs 17.1x/20.9x/27.2x) is excluded: TTM FCF conversion of 127.8% is anomalously elevated versus FY2025's 100.0% (factsheet Quality table, 'falling -16.2pp' trend over FY2021-25 despite the TTM uptick), making its re-rating comparison unreliable. Spread (81.29-67.30=13.99), half (6.99), relative to the 68.00 target = 10.29%; below the 0.22374078380887447 blended residual vol in 2026-10-07-mc-inputs.json.

base.probability_evidence: The current 15.4x P/E is already close to the WTS/PNR/LII/MAS peer median (15.8x) and only modestly below it on EV/EBITDA (10.4x vs 11.7x, -11%) (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Valuation), so continuation of today's multiple regime -- with the 8.37% FCF yield and -3.71% YoY buyback-driven share count doing the per-share work (factsheet ST/Valuation) -- is the modal outcome absent a confirmed China resolution or a deeper guidance cut; this is the largest weight (45%) as the status-quo case ahead of Q3 results on Oct 29, 2026.

target_band.cite: Base basis holds multiples 'near the current 15.4x P/E' (research/AOS/2026-10-07-evaluation.md scenarios.base.basis) rather than re-rating toward any multiple's own 5y range; applying that same 'multiple unchanged' assumption to EV/EBITDA (10.4x), EV/Sales (2.1x) and P/B (4.2x) at their current levels yields an identical implied price (the 56.90 close itself, factsheet-2026-10-07.md Price) under all four anchors, so there is no anchor disagreement to band beyond the already-measured residual volatility.

bear.probability_evidence: ROIC has fallen every year from 40.6% (FY2022) to 23.0% TTM and ROCE has rolled over from 31.9% (FY2025) to 24.9% TTM (factsheet-2026-10-07.md Quality); China third-party sales fell 28% YoY with segment margin down to 5.2% from 10.5%, and management's FY2026 guidance explicitly excludes any tariff impact (note.md §2,§6, 10-Q); net debt/EBITDA moved from net cash to 0.63x after the debt-funded Leonard Valve deal while buybacks continue (note.md §5); short interest is elevated at 9.80% of float, consistent with bearish positioning into the Oct 29, 2026 print (factsheet Other/News) -- set at 30%, the largest downside weight given the unresolved China drag and unquantified tariff risk.

target_band.cite: Bear basis holds P/E 'unchanged' at 15.4x while earnings fall (research/AOS/2026-10-07-evaluation.md scenarios.bear.basis); applying the same 'multiple unchanged, metric falls proportionally' assumption to EV/EBITDA (10.4x), EV/Sales (2.1x) and P/B (4.2x) at their current levels yields an identical proportional de-rating under all four anchors, so there is no anchor disagreement to band beyond the already-measured residual volatility.
